meta.projection_note: proj_home_margin = slope x (home net - away net) + intercept, fit walk-forward on prior weeks; a sanity check, not a fair line (QB changes are not modeled)
meta.grade_scale: percentile of opponent-adjusted value among all team-games W1..N: A+>=95 A>=85 B>=65 C>=35 D>=15 F<15
meta.caveat: One game is noise. Grades say how a unit played relative to the opponent's usual level, not who is good.
